name: Theodora
summary: Interactive trophic-extermination cascade and subterranean incunabula bestiary cutaway where purging every living plague from condors to poison-immune rat clans sterilizes Theodora into cement and awakens nine forgotten mythic beasts from the library basement.
inner_arch: Every biological extermination in Theodora causally unleashes the next trophic plague until humanity achieves aseptic cement solitude (livingFaunaCount === 0, Buffon & Linnaeus shelved), unlocking the forgotten basement incunabula from which sphinxes, griffons, chimeras, dragons, hircocervi, harpies, hydras, unicorns, and basilisks reclaim the dreaming city.
anti_trude_vector: Three-tier limestone-to-cement architectural cross-section and interactive trophic-cascade ledger paired with illuminated medieval bestiary vellum folios and procedural WebAudio.
medium: Bespoke Custom-Element HTML5 + Dual-Layer Canvas2D Architectural/Bestiary Cutaway + Procedural WebAudio Synthesizer

canonical_stones.stone: Slaying condors removes aerial predation and causes serpents to multiply unconstrained across courtyards and cisterns.
Exterminating serpents yields spider-webbed colonnades; wiping out spiders causes flies to blacken the sky.
Fumigating flies yields timber-devouring termites; crushing termites leaves the city prey to woodworms, driving citizens to replace all wood with stone and cement.
Violent massacre of poison-immune rat clans leaves Theodora an aseptic cement human sanctuary (livingFaunaCount === 0) with Buffon and Linnaeus locked away as library volumes.

Down in the library basement's dusty incunabula and bestiaries, sleeping mythic fauna stirs awake as citizens dream: sphinxes plant lions' claws on pavement alongside griffons, chimeras, dragons, hircocervi, harpies, hydras, unicorns, and basilisks.
